events.description: CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief warns that Bin Ladin and associates are making near-term threats and may launch multiple attacks.
Arab news channel reported Bin Ladin was interviewed the previous week, and said to expect a "severe blow" against US and Israeli interests within two weeks.
Arab news correspondent interviewed Bin Ladin in Afghanistan under security measures (week before the 23 June report).

An Arab news channel's correspondent reportedly interviewed Bin Ladin in Afghanistan 'last week' (before the 25 June 2001 brief). Bin Ladin said to expect a 'severe blow' against US and Israeli interests within two weeks. The station showed no footage.
The Arab news channel reported on Saturday the interview with Bin Ladin and his threat of a 'severe blow' against US and Israeli interests during the next two weeks.
The CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief reported that Bin Ladin and associates were making near-term threats and planning multiple attacks.

key_claims: As of 25 June 2001 the CIA assessed that Bin Ladin and associates were preparing multiple near-term attacks.
Bin Ladin reportedly publicly threatened a "severe blow" to US and Israeli interests within two weeks.
The correspondent's description of security measures during the interview was judged consistent with (redacted) reporting, though no footage substantiated the claim.
